name: @zoltar/chaos
description: Long-running randomized Zoltar ecosystem transaction operator

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run format:check
scripts.format: bun x @biomejs/biome format --write package.json tsconfig.json bunfig.toml README.md OPERATOR_REFERENCE.md src tests scripts config
scripts.format:check: bun x @biomejs/biome format package.json tsconfig.json bunfig.toml README.md OPERATOR_REFERENCE.md src tests scripts config
scripts.lint: bun x @biomejs/biome lint package.json tsconfig.json bunfig.toml src tests scripts config
scripts.typecheck: bun run ensure-contract-artifacts && bun x tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit
